chapter_title: Molecular Pharmacology of Nucleoside and Nucleotide HIV-1 Reverse Transcriptase Inhibitors
source_pdf: /mnt/project-files/Experimental Provenance for QSAR Dataset/Pharmacology (Luca Gallelli) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

records.role_detail: competitive inhibitor of dNTP substrate binding/incorporation (NRTI-triphosphates, class statement)
records.mechanism_book_wording: NRTI-triphosphates (NRTI-TP) inhibit RT-catalyzed proviral DNA synthesis by two mechanisms. First, they are competitive inhibitors for binding and/or catalytic incorporation with respect to the analogous natural dNTP substrate.
records.quote: competitive inhibitors for binding and/or catalytic incorporation with respect to the analogous natural dNTP substrate
records.notes: Class-level statement with no single compound named; the NRTI-triphosphate is the active form (book: nucleoside analogs are metabolised to triphosphates). Statement begins at the bottom of PDF page 75 ('NRTI-triphosphates (NRTI-TP) inhibit RT-catalyzed proviral DNA synthesis by two mechanisms. First, they are').

records.mechanism_book_wording: Second, they terminate further viral DNA synthesis due to the lack of a 3'-OH group. Chain termination is the principal mechanism of NRTI antiviral action
records.quote: Chain termination is the principal mechanism of NRTI antiviral action
records.notes: Class-level statement; second of the two mechanisms. Book also says about 20,000 nucleotide incorporation events per viral DNA and about 5000 chances for chain termination (not recorded as a number for a compound).

records.mechanism_book_wording: zidovudine-MP acts as a substrate inhibitor of dTMP kinase and limits its own conversion to the 5'-DP form
records.quote: zidovudine-MP acts as a substrate inhibitor of dTMP kinase and limits its own conversion to the 5'-DP form
records.numbers_detail: apparent Michaelis constant (Km) of zidovudine-MP for dTMP kinase 'almost equivalent to that of dTMP'; maximum kinetic rate (Vmax) 'only 0.3 %' that of dTMP (PDF page 76)
records.notes: Metabolite of zidovudine acting on a host enzyme; stated in the zidovudine section. Target class (enzyme) is inferred from 'kinase'; the page does not use the word enzyme for dTMP kinase.

records.role_detail: chain terminator; substrate recognised and incorporated by RT
records.mechanism_book_wording: ddATP is the active metabolite that is recognized by HIV-1 RT and incorporated into the nascent viral DNA chain causing chain-termination
records.quote: ddATP is the active metabolite that is recognized by HIV-1 RT and incorporated into the nascent viral DNA chain causing chain-termination
records.notes: Only compound-specific statement in the chapter that names RT as the target of a single approved NRTI's active metabolite. Other NRTIs (zidovudine, stavudine, lamivudine, emtricitabine, abacavir, tenofovir, apricitabine, festinavir, amdoxovir, GS-7340, CMX-157) are described by activation pathway and pharmacokinetics; the chapter treats them as NRTI via the class statements above, with no separate RT-inhibition sentence per compound, so no per-drug RT records were written for them.

records.drug: Tenofovir-MP and tenofovir-DP (mono- and di-phosphate forms of tenofovir)
records.mechanism_book_wording: the mono- and di-phosphate forms both inhibit purine nucleoside phosphorylase which is responsible for base removal of didanosine to form hypoxanthine
records.quote: the mono- and di-phosphate forms both inhibit purine nucleoside phosphorylase
records.notes: Sentence is at the top of printed page 69, continuing the tenofovir section from PDF page 80. 'The mono- and di-phosphate forms' is read as tenofovir-MP and tenofovir-DP from context (inference).

chapter_notes: Skipped 2 statements whose targets are neither receptor nor enzyme (apricitabine weak inhibitor of P-glycoprotein; CMX-157 proposed lipid insertion into the viral envelope). Also not recorded: negative statements (no inhibition of cytochrome P450 for abacavir and tenofovir; festinavir 'little or no inhibition of host polymerases'; no effect of apricitabine on P450 or glucuronidase) and competition of lamivudine/emtricitabine with apricitabine for deoxycytidine kinase phosphorylation, which is a substrate competition effect not stated as inhibition.
